title: Lonnie Zamora sighting near nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Well, Lonnie Zamora happened a couple miles from the

plain: In 1964 a police officer named Lonnie Zamora reported a strange craft near Socorro, New Mexico, and Michels says the spot was only a couple of miles from sensitive nuclear sites. He raises it himself, without naming a source, in a debate with a skeptic, as part of a pattern of sightings near nuclear facilities, which would suggest the craft take an interest in nuclear weapons.
